scope: Automatic C# tests and Godot production matrix. OS keyboard and mouse acceptance is recorded separately.
countingRule: Counts use final-run checkpoint sample arrays aggregating saved and restored branches. Each sampled attempt is counted, including abandoned pre-restore attempts. Receipt dictionaries are not counted.
rngRule: Each fishing attempt previews xorshift32 (13,17,5), modulo 100. Succeeded attempts advance RNG state. inventory_full preserves RNG state and retains the previewed roll in the result.
